goal: Rename every 'foo' identifier in src/ to 'bar' without breaking the tests.

steps.title: Grep for every 'foo' identifier under src/ to build the rename list (skip test fixtures and third-party modules)
Rename each 'foo' identifier to 'bar' across src/**/*.py
Run the test suite and confirm zero 'foo' identifiers remain in src/

acceptance.description: 'bar' identifiers are present in src/ (the rename actually happened)
the test suite still passes after the rename
